DraftOdds.captain: Seed {seed} is high enough to captain one of the {alliances} alliances.
DraftOdds.oprUp: Seed {seed} gives {basePct}%, but sitting in the event's {oprPct}th OPR percentile raises it: captains look at capability, not just the standings.
DraftOdds.oprDown: Seed {seed} gives {basePct}%, but an OPR in the {oprPct}th percentile lowers it — at equal seed, captains prefer the higher scorer.
